name: Broken Hearted
source:
Broken Hearted follows Nat Levy, a 23 year old New Yorker, as he remembers the love of his life, Heather, and tries to cope with her loss on 9/11. It is a story of love, sadness... and hope.

[Edited from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20061213101615/http://www.9-11game.com/]Official site[/url]]
translation:
《Broken Hearted》讲述二十三岁的纽约人纳特·利维回忆一生挚爱希瑟，并试图面对她在9·11事件中离世的故事。这是一个关于爱、悲伤……以及希望的故事。

[改编自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20061213101615/http://www.9-11game.com/]官方网站[/url]]
